payload.claim_boundary: This retrospective receipt binds a source recording hash to timestamped, visible page states and a previously signed software release. It proves that those pixels and audio bytes exist in that recording and that the displayed local checkpoint roots changed as documented. It does not prove actor identity, accurate diarization, transcript accuracy, provider-side deletion, exclusive backend-session attribution, clinical truth, immutability, non-repudiation, HIPAA compliance, or that a public room update occurred.
